entities.name: Kynureninase-like protein
observations: 423-aa sequence; calculated mass 47.84 kDa, theoretical pI 5.70, instability index 32.10, GRAVY −0.223.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial kynureninases: 50.8–51.7% identity, 96.5–98.8% query coverage; functional assignment is homology-supported, not experimentally established for this query.
Likely PLP-dependent kynureninase (EC 3.7.1.3), catalyzing kynurenine and 3-hydroxykynurenine cleavage to anthranilate/3-hydroxyanthranilate plus alanine.

entities.name: UniProt Q1ITW5
observations: Reviewed Koribacter versatilis kynureninase; annotated PLP cofactor and EC 3.7.1.3; cleaves L-kynurenine and L-3-hydroxykynurenine.
